tagline: Point-and-click web scraping — no code needed

listExtractor.title: Get a list from this page
listExtractor.description: Products, jobs, results or table rows, as a spreadsheet
listExtractor.tooltip: Click any repeating element on a page — products, jobs, prices, news — and export a clean spreadsheet or JSON in seconds

aiExtract.title: AI Extract
aiExtract.description: Describe the data you want; AI in Chrome fills it from the page
aiExtract.tooltip: Give a schema (fields, lists, a JSON Schema or an example) and Chrome's built-in model fills it from the current page. Every value is checked against the page; nothing leaves your browser.

textSummarizer.title: Page assistant
textSummarizer.description: What matters on this page, and answers you can check on it
textSummarizer.tooltip: A brief made for the kind of page (product, article, job, docs…), with every point linked to where the page says it. Ask questions; runs on your device

pageExtractor.title: Same details from many pages
pageExtractor.description: A list of pages; the same details from each, or their article text
pageExtractor.tooltip: Define your fields once, then CrawlPilot visits each URL automatically — great for lead research, pricing audits and content collection at scale

metadataExtractor.title: Article text from many pages
metadataExtractor.description: Title, author, date and full text from a list of pages
metadataExtractor.tooltip: No selectors needed — supply URLs and get back structured data: title, author, publish date, keywords and the full page content in Markdown

imageDownloader.title: Download images
imageDownloader.description: Every image on this page, ready to save
imageDownloader.tooltip: Preview all images on the current page, pick the ones you need, and batch-download product photos, gallery assets or design references instantly

browserUtilities.title: Copy & right-click unlock
browserUtilities.description: Re-enable right-click & text selection on sites that block them
browserUtilities.tooltip: Unlock copy, paste and right-click menus on sites that restrict them — ideal for copying quotes, URLs and content from protected pages

scraperToolkit.title: Scraper Toolkit
scraperToolkit.description: For developers: how to scrape a page, selectors, its API
scraperToolkit.tooltip: Page Recon, Selector Lab and API Finder: learn how to scrape a page, find selectors that last, and the API behind its data
